She speaks animatedly with wide eyes and points her index finger upward. The background is a dimly lit indoor space with black walls and a yellow power cord hanging vertically behind her. (2) The camera pans to the left to show a male coworker sitting at a long wooden workbench in an industrial-style studio or office. He has short black hair, wears a black t-shirt and a wristwatch, and works on a silver laptop. Behind him, shelves are filled with various tools, containers, and hardware, and another person with long dark hair sits nearby. (3) The perspective shifts back to the pink-haired woman as she walks through the studio, passing several coworkers. She approaches a man in a denim jacket and glasses who laughs and covers his mouth, then moves toward a man with bleached orange hair wearing a black and white athletic shirt. The lighting is bright and industrial with exposed ceiling fixtures and hanging lamps. (4) The woman walks toward a plain white door at the end of a corridor and opens it to reveal a large, open-plan bathroom. (5) The camera explores the restroom interior, showing two white porcelain toilets and two urinals positioned side-by-side in the same open space without any partitions or stalls. (6) A montage of reaction shots follows, featuring different coworkers in the office laughing and talking about the bizarre bathroom layout. The camera focuses on their facial expressions, including a man sitting with his head in his hands next to a red cup, and another man in a grey hoodie smiling. (7) A series of three still photographs appears on screen, showing the pink-haired woman and another woman in a light blue sweater posing together in the restroom, giving thumbs-up signs and smiling. Sparkle effects are added over the images. (8) A woman with long dark hair and a light blue cardigan is shown walking towards the restroom entrance, looking curious and then laughing as she enters. The scene concludes with her and the pink-haired woman standing together in the office area, talking and laughing while the camera remains handheld and slightly shaky.
